summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston begin reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, mocking its self-insert general in Afghanistan, its racist portrayal of Black characters, and its strawman Democratic president.

evidence.note: novel identified as published in 2016 by a conservative press
first chapter places the general pinned down in Kabul as the war collapses
high school flashback with a Black classmate cast as a future prisoner; hosts call it racist
fictional Democratic president chases reelection through social spending; hosts read it as an Obama stand-in
hosts note the work freedom program echoes the Auschwitz gate slogan
rancher militia storyline tied to an undocumented Mexican worker and LA gang violence
Detroit chapter for a Black character opens with demeaning framing of the city

notes: First episode of the multi-part True Allegiance reading. Time is the 2016 publication and its unspecified near-present setting (approximate). Afghanistan setting is fictional. propaganda-media chosen as the closest primary theme, matching sibling records; no theme fits right-wing polemical fiction exactly. Character name spellings are approximate from the transcript.
